description: Implement prediction engine orchestrator, market derivation, MENSIONE pick generation, prediction versioning, database persistence, and AnalysisContext enrichment
steps: Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\market_derivation.py with MarketDerivationEngine per design.md section 14 - derives all markets from score distribution

Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\engine.py with PredictionEngine orchestrator class per design.md section 16 - coordinates entire prediction pipeline
Add prediction versioning to c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\database\models.py: PredictionVersion, PredictionRun tables per design.md section 17
Create Alembic migration for new prediction_versions and prediction_runs tables
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\persistence.py with PredictionPersistenceService for database storage
Update c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\analysis\context.py to enrich AnalysisContext with prediction engine outputs (maintain backward compatibility)

All tests pass including original 651 tests
